name: Baptornis
sum: Flightless diving bird of the Western Interior Seaway, about 87 to 80 million years ago.
holotype: Material named by Marsh (1877) from Kansas (specimen in the original description).
material: Several specimens from the Niobrara Chalk and other marine rocks.
biology: Probably hunted smaller, more agile prey than its larger relatives, holding it with its jaws rather than spearing it, somewhat like a darter.
author: Marsh 1877
